score_rationale.technical: The entire 18-page argument is coherent, resources and limit order are specified, the new arbitrary-noise and minimax claims have valid public-environment accounting, the absolute-width identity and source conversions are correct, the added supplement reproduces and all pages are legible. No unresolved material objection. This is a high-confidence involved mathematical review, not formal or independent human verification.
score_rationale.importance: Exceptional specialized contribution centered on a dimension-independent stopped-classification recovery theorem and its absolute entanglement gaps. The integrated isotropic interval supplies a useful absolute refinement of the established relative approximation; six-capacity minimax places the application in a recognized communication problem. The minimax machinery and first four guarantees are largely standard consequences and do not by themselves raise the work to a field-shaping score. Unknown depolarizing rates remain unknown; nonoptimal constants, weak low-dimensional bounds, asymptotic/non-efficient protocols and limited priority verification also constrain the rating. The same 9/7 numerals as an earlier round are a present judgment, not a transferred score or accumulated vote.

optional_revisions.suggestion: State explicitly that one may choose the ideal uniform-message state tensor the actual Eve marginal. Replacing another independent comparison state costs at most a factor two in secrecy error, after which the public-seed direct-sum average and deterministic selection are immediate.

Both exhibited minimizers are entanglement breaking: their isotropic Choi fidelities are zero or (d^-2-lambda)/(1-lambda)<=d^-2. Thus minimization over all CPTP noise or EB noise has the same value. This clarifies why the universal guarantee is broader although the worst-case noise need not be entangling.
The 1999 BSST reference is sufficient and correct; optionally add quant-ph/0106052, Theorem1, for the detailed general EA capacity proof.

For quicker source navigation, also point to Singh-Nechita Proposition4.1 for the explicit direct sum and Holevo Proposition3 for constrained classical regularization. Current references identify adequate sources.

claims.claim: Universal stopped classification and CLDUI interval
claims.basis: Finite Z3 twirl preserves B; average over invertible binary A plus concavity fixes one low-entropy A; parity Kraus acts as projector/sqrt2; finite-stage typical hashing costs H(J)<=h(w)+2(1-w); survivor MC hashing and actual-survivor seed pay the reserve. Bell fidelity decouples full purification and transcript. CLDUI diagonal separable reference gives ER<=v.
Known equality block and 2x2 blocks give C_Delta=v+c with 0<=c<=1-w. Twirl removes swaps, and separable dephasing supplies ER upper. Hence log2(9), with no EC claim.

Apply classification to actual accepted state, use three-branch entropy identity and nonnegative MC noise coherent information. No matching marginal. Cost upper requires a pure useful state and separable noise; mixed MC upper is ER, not EC.
Choi distillation lower and channel squashed-entanglement adaptive upper. No covariance or replacement assumption.

claims.claim: Six guarantees for arbitrary finite noise
claims.basis: Basis-ensemble entropy bounds for C; Bell-input coherent/mutual information for Q/P/CEA; accepted rectangular branch for Q2/K2, without imposing a failure marginal. Replacement choice supplies upper bound on infimum only.

Unitary-orbit derandomization for C/Q/CEA; coherent-environment dephasing plus deterministic seed selection for P; fresh public seed and full-record security for Q2/K2. f>=lambda, nonnegative-parameter postprocessing for lambda>=d^-2; explicit CPTP minimizers in both regimes. Rectangular decoder and embedded minimizers are valid.
King and BSST formulas after conversion from depolarization parameter to entangled fraction. No new general quantum/private evaluation.

claims.claim: Absolute isotropic interval and positivity threshold
claims.basis: Block eigenvalues and entropy identity give U-L=min(U,(1-f)A_d) exactly for the displayed interval; A_d->2. PLOB REE upper and teleportation simulation identify channel/state two-way capacities. Isotropic distillability threshold supplies positivity even if quantitative lower bound is zero. No assertion ED=KD or exact positive values.

claims.claim: Four reset capacity limits and hidden-branch estimate
claims.basis: Exact replacement-map diamond distance, cq conditional entropy bound in correct direction, finite decoded coding and erasure postprocessing. Physical reset may have infinite entropy/energy; no illicit coding formula applied directly there.

Shifted truncated geometric formula gives strict energy slack and absolute entropy loss o(1); fixed trace-class reset tail vanishes. Blocklength first, energy second; uniformity only over bounded reset-energy sets.

claims.claim: Two-way reset limits and distributed-state reversibility
claims.basis: Paid finite-input seed and same-copy energy accounting; DSW adaptive mean-energy upper applied to erasure. Local preparation of arbitrary trace-class reset permitted for state EC; no channel-simulation cost claim.
Use M=Psi^tensor n finite at each n; convex output-entropy roof bounds every survivor branch, then constrained regularization. Avoids unproved induction with infinite partner channels.
Block-average energy time sharing for lambda>1/2; antidegradability otherwise. Fixed two-dimensional escaping block yields negative partial-transpose expectation for any lambda>0.

limitations: Same involved model reviewer, not a new independent or blind vote, not human peer review or formal verification; runtime model identity not independently attested.
Targeted source comparison does not certify exhaustive priority; standard breeding, reduction, twirling, classical formulas and isotropic normalized prelog are prior work.
Constants need not be optimal or informative at low dimension; no efficient implementation or quantitative seed-rate bound.
No general mixed-state EC reversibility, no LDOI EC-ED bound and no resolution of NPT bound entanglement.
Minimax is over known fixed memoryless CPTP noise. Codes may depend on the channel; no compound/adversarial noise protection.
Minimax reduction does not evaluate general positive depolarizing Q/P or ED/KD; absolute interval width is not the actual gap and does not imply ED=KD.
The oscillator reset density is fixed before N tends to infinity; no uniform convergence over all densities, arbitrary changing resets or general infinite-dimensional input-dependent noise.
No finite-energy exact reset capacity, quantum/private arbitrary-partner additivity, constrained local formation cost or channel simulation cost.
Algebraic numerical checks do not establish operational coding, privacy or novelty. Reviewer did not recompile; visual/text integrity checked on exact supplied PDF.
Grades and recommendation apply only to the exact immutable artifacts inventoried here. Prior reviews remain frozen.
